CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
February 13, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
6.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 23, 2024.
6.1 Minutes of 1-23-24 CC
6.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated February 13, 2024 in the total amount of $3,791,130.95.
6.2 Warrant Register - City
6.3
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with Chandler Asset Management and authorize the City Manager on behalf of the City to execute an agreement for a three-year period with two one-year options.
6.3 Agreement for Investment Management Services
6.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING DECEMBER 2023 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending December 2023.
6.4 Investment Report for December 2023
6.5
CITY OF LA MIRADA FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS REPORT FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Financial Transactions Report for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
6.5 Financial Transactions Report
6.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-11, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD DRAINAGE IMPROVEMENTS - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Lucas Builders, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
6.6 CIP No. 2021-11
6.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-03, NEW CABARET LOUNGE AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2023-03, New Cabaret Lounge at the La Mirada Theatre, to Corner Keystone Construction Corp. in the amount of $247,700; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction inspection and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project construction cost.
6.7 CIP No. 2023-03
6.8
FACILITY WINDOW CLEANING SERVICES - REVIEW OF PROPOSALS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for facility window cleaning services to Eastside Window Cleaning Service; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional services up to 20 percent of the total contract cost.
6.8 Agreement for Facility Window Cleaning
6.9
STORM DRAIN CATCH BASIN TRASH CAPTURE DEVICES, CIP NO. 2024-01 - APPROVAL OF PURCHASE AND INSTALL AGREEMENT WITH G2 CONSTRUCTION, INC., AND APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH WILLDAN ENGINEERING FOR MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement with G2 Construction, Inc, for the purchase and installation of storm drain catch basin trash capture devices on catch basins in the City of La Mirada using the terms and pricing from the County of Orange Master Agreement in the amount of $688,623; approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and Willdan Engineering to provide professional management and inspection services for CIP No. 2024-01, Storm Drain Catch Basin Trash Capture Devices, based on the Willdan Engineering proposal dated December 13, 2023, in the amount of $50,016; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost for each agreement.
6.9 CIP No. 2024-01
7.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
7.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 732 REVISING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO ENTERTAINMENT PERMITS AND AMENDING TITLE 4 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 732 revising regulations applicable to entertainment permits and amending Title 4 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
7.1 Ordinance No. 732 - 2nd Reading
